scope.input: recognized Taiwan top-level administrative region prefix, or explicitly allowlisted locality-only alias, with optional trailing locality text only for top-level-prefix inputs

activation: birthplace supplied and explicit IANA timezone omitted
precedence: explicit IANA timezone remains authoritative and bypasses this resolver
boundaries: timezone resolution does not imply exact-place geocoding
timezone resolution does not imply birthplace-to-longitude admission
true solar time still requires explicit admitted profile plus longitude
Astrology place-resolver admission is not inherited
locality-only aliases are explicit allowlist entries only; no fuzzy place-name inference
